title: Biocatalytic synthesis of the non-pungent capsaicinoid olvanil from agri-food waste
content:
RSC Sustainability, 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5SU00241A, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Celeste Nobbio, Daniele Fiorito, Eda Kocer, Stefano Magni, Erica Elisa Ferrandi, Daniela Monti, Elisabetta Brenna, Davide Tessaro, Fabio Parmeggiani
A simple biocatalytic two-step process has been optimised to produce the capsaicinoid olvanil, starting from biomass-derived oleic acid and vanillin and using only biobased reagents and catalysts.
